title: Object Storage: suspension grace days
content:
Object Storage suspension grace days is defined as follows: Calendar days after invoice maturity before collection suspension; integer.

| Contract tier | Suspension grace days |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | suspension grace days: 15 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | suspension grace days: 15 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | suspension grace days: 15 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | suspension grace days: 15 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | suspension grace days: 15 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | suspension grace days: 15 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the suspension grace days entry is 15.
